nodes.summary: Adjoining a root of a monic polynomial whose non-leading coefficients lie in the maximal ideal and whose constant coefficient lies outside the square of the maximal ideal preserves regularity and Krull dimension.
nodes.title: Adjoining a root of an Eisenstein-like polynomial preserves regularity

nodes.summary: A regular local ring of Krull dimension at most one is a domain and integrally closed.
nodes.title: Regular local rings of dimension at most one are normal domains

nodes.summary: Multivariable power series over a regular local ring form a regular local ring. The discrete-valuation-ring case follows by typeclass inference, since a DVR is a regular local ring.
nodes.title: Multivariable power series over a regular local ring are regular local
Power series over a regular local ring

nodes.summary: Quotienting a regular local ring by a parameter outside the square of the maximal ideal and outside every minimal prime stays regular, with the embedding dimension dropping by exactly one.
nodes.title: Quotient of a regular local ring by a regular parameter is regular

nodes.summary: A Noetherian local domain is a unique factorization monoid when quotienting by a principal prime ideal gives a principal ideal ring.
nodes.title: Unique factorization from a principal ideal ring quotient

nodes.summary: A regular local ring of Krull dimension at most two is a unique factorization monoid.
nodes.title: Regular local rings of dimension at most two are UFDs

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
